patch.objective: Incident response activities as SY0-701 names them: preparation, detection, analysis, containment, eradication, recovery, lessons learned; training; testing (tabletop exercise, simulation); root cause analysis; threat hunting; digital forensics (legal hold, chain of custody, acquisition, reporting, preservation, e-discovery)
secondaryObjectives: Security governance documents: guidelines; policies (acceptable use policy (AUP), information security policies, business continuity, disaster recovery, incident response, software development lifecycle (SDLC), change management); standards (password, access control, physical security, encryption); procedures (change management, onboarding/offboarding, playbooks)
